observations: The page number «33» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. At the foot, the signature line of the printed sheet: «D. K. D. Vidensk. Selsk. Skr., 7. Række, hist. og filos. Afd. III. 1.» on the left and the sheet number «5» on the right; recorded here, not transcribed as a line.

L19: «3s 23° 25′ 48″ (= 113° 25′ 48″)», the s raised. Checked: three signs of 30 degrees and 23 degrees are 113 degrees. To be compared with Table 4. L18: the epoch of the Hijra, 15 July 622; L23: the era of Yazdegird, 16 June 632. Checked: 15 July 622 (Julian) is the day 1948439 of the Julian period, a Thursday, the astronomical epoch of the Hijra; 16 June 632 is the day 1952063, a Tuesday, the epoch of the era of Yazdegird; the two epochs are 3624 days apart.

Spaced type, marked {sp:}: the names, «Kh.», «Perser», «Ptolemäus», «Ptolomaeus», «Batt.», «Lippert», «Suter»; italics: the Indian and Arabic words and names of places, «Radix» (L16), «Muḥarram», «Hidjra» (L21), «Aera», «Almagest» and the title in N02. L18: «Radix» and «Hidjra» upright. L15: «(g. B. 23° 11′, g. L. 75° 52′ Gr.)», geographical latitude and longitude east of Greenwich, with no stop after the bracket.
The colon and the semicolons stand after the thin space of the edition (12-14 px measured).
